Reference image for the [[Jokes]] block on [[Princess Leia]]: Han Solo and Princess Leia kiss in the carbon-freezing chamber on Cloud City in ''The Empire Strikes Back'' (1980), moments before Leia says "I love you" and Han answers "I know".

Source: a frame at 0:36 of [https://www.starwars.com/video/carbon-freeze Carbon-Freeze], StarWars.com, the official Lucasfilm clip of the scene (1280 by 720 pixels). The letterbox bars were removed and the frame reduced to 1000 by 427 pixels. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008223717/https://www.starwars.com/video/carbon-freeze Internet Archive], 8 October 2026. SHA-256 of the uploaded file: 3a29d745c6e71b257c3eed661502810f601800d9d04aa4c4cdbf1a10b730a4eb.

License: Non-free. Fair-use rationale: a single reduced-size still from ''The Empire Strikes Back'' (1980), © Lucasfilm Ltd., used only to show the scene the card's lore refers to, beside the card on [[Jokes]], on a non-commercial fan wiki. It cannot replace the film or harm its market, and no free image of the scene exists.
